Subject: Renewal & billing options for OrbisData - upcoming Sep 30 renewal

Hi Priya,

Quick note — your annual subscription is up for renewal on 2026-09-30. With procurement shifting toward centralized invoicing at OrbisData, I wanted to outline an alternative that customers find simplifies purchasing and reduces internal PO churn: moving the contract to Azure Marketplace billing.

High level:
- Marketplace billing (metered or SaaS subscription) lets Procurement buy directly through Microsoft and simplifies reconciliation.
- We can preserve current pricing/term economics, or map to an equivalent Marketplace SKU — we typically do pricing parity for customers moving during renewal.
- Migration takes ~3 weeks for entitlement mapping and billing entitlements once procurement signs the marketplace purchase order (we'll handle most of the integration).

Attached: marketplace_move_summary.pdf — one-page overview for your procurement team.

Questions I have for you: who in Procurement should I loop in (I saw Mark Chen on your previous renewal threads)? Do you have any constraints around DocuSign or third-party marketplace procurement approvals?

If moving to Marketplace looks promising, I can pull in our Marketplace channel lead and finance to draft the entitlement mapping and a short amendment that keeps your SLA and seat counts intact.

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min call to walk through.

Best,

Thanks Lauren — we can own this. Quick plan and checklist for moving OrbisData to Azure Marketplace:

Marketplace migration checklist (estimate ~2–3 weeks):
- 1) Entitlement mapping: map current subscription seats to a Marketplace SKU (no price change by default).
- 2) Channel routing: enable co-sell flag if Orbis wants Microsoft incentives (we'll need the co-sell intake).
- 3) Billing cadence: create monthly metered SKU variant; confirm with Finance if monthly reporting is required.
- 4) DocuSign amendment: Legal-approved marketplace amendment to be signed by Orbis (Aditya to confirm final text).
- 5) Provision & validation: after purchase in Azure, validate entitlement sync in our backend (we handle technical cutover).

On pricing parity: we typically honor existing committed pricing for customers moving at renewal. Marketplace transaction fees (if any) are usually absorbed by the vendor or passed as a line item — we'll confirm which path Orbis prefers and surface that for approval.

On credits: Marcus — Finance will need invoice numbers and date ranges. If Orbis migrates effective 2026-09-01 we can issue pro-rated credit for the remaining subscription days on the previous billing cycle. I'll include sample credit memo language in the checklist.

Next actions: I'll send the DocuSign draft link and a short one-page procurement note for Priya/Mark to hand to compliance. Can we aim to have the DocuSign to them by EOD Monday?
